data.title: Astronomy club meeting
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Thanks for coming tonight. I'm Ingrid Solberg, I coordinate volunteers for the Northbank Astronomy Club. Speaker 2: Happy to be here. Speaker 1: We need someone to run a telescope at the public outreach night on the eighteenth. Speaker 2: Count me in, I'll take a telescope that night. Speaker 1: Wonderful. Also, early registration for the regional amateur astronomy conference closes Sunday. Speaker 2: Good to know, I'll register before then.

contact.name: Ingrid Solberg
contact.context: Met at an astronomy club meeting; she coordinates the club's volunteers.

tasks.content: Run a telescope at the club's public outreach night
Register for the regional amateur astronomy conference
